review.scope: Foundation pilot, second increment: collections and mathematical sets, cardinality, set operations, and misplaced runtime concepts.
review.context_policy: Preserve all existing home contexts. Mathematics uses U1 with explicit U3 genera for existing programming terminology and U5 for concept extension. No new U2 records. Subset and universal set are roles relative to a specified containing set/domain.
review.limits: These classifications do not encode arbitrary element membership or implement set algebra. Empty set is a mathematical object, not an empty catalog extension. The legacy collection children and its quantity-frequency edge remain pending. General idempotence, parser associativity, everyday homonyms, model children, and relational-property specificity require separate review. Algebraic classifications use the usual binary operations on subsets of a fixed domain.

concepts.name: математическое множество
concepts.reason: An abstract set with determined membership. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-1-basic-set-concepts

concepts.name: конечное множество
concepts.reason: Its cardinality is a nonnegative integer, including zero. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-1-basic-set-concepts

concepts.name: непустое множество
concepts.reason: Has at least one element. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-1-basic-set-concepts

concepts.name: пустое множество
concepts.reason: The unique set with zero elements. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-1-basic-set-concepts

concepts.name: собственное подмножество
concepts.reason: A subset unequal to its specified containing set; A is contained in B and A differs from B. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-2-subsets

concepts.name: универсальное множество
concepts.reason: The chosen domain U for a problem, never an unrestricted set of all sets. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-4-set-operations-with-two-sets

concepts.name: мощность множества
concepts.reason: The size attribute, for finite and infinite sets. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-1-basic-set-concepts

concepts.name: бесконечная мощность множества
concepts.reason: Size that is not finite. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-1-basic-set-concepts

concepts.name: бинарная математическая операция
concepts.reason: A function S x S to S on a specified carrier S. Source: https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/6-972-algebraic-techniques-and-semidefinite-optimization-spring-2006/c3ae2c6021ca407a180a89c01e2cb4a1_lecture_04.pdf

concepts.name: операция над множествами
concepts.reason: A mathematical operation whose operands and result are sets. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-4-set-operations-with-two-sets

concepts.name: объединение множеств (операция)
concepts.reason: Binary operation: x belongs to the result iff x belongs to A or B. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-4-set-operations-with-two-sets

concepts.name: пересечение множеств (операция)
concepts.reason: Binary operation: x belongs to the result iff x belongs to both A and B. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-4-set-operations-with-two-sets

concepts.name: разность множеств (операция)
concepts.reason: Binary operation: x belongs to the result iff x belongs to A but not B. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-4-set-operations-with-two-sets

concepts.name: дополнение множества (операция)
concepts.reason: Unary operation for fixed U: sends A to U minus A. Source: https://openstax.org/books/contemporary-mathematics/pages/1-4-set-operations-with-two-sets
